missing_information_behavior: Do not add iron until elemental iron per serving, frequency, duration, prenatal products and clinical indication are reconciled.
safety_exclusions: Do not equate iron salt mass with elemental iron.
Do not add iron on top of prescribed treatment without clinician instruction.
Do not infer iron deficiency from fatigue or diet alone.
professional_escalation_conditions: Known iron overload/hemochromatosis, abnormal ferritin or transferrin saturation, gastrointestinal symptoms or suspected overdose.
Pregnancy or diagnosed anemia requires clinician-directed management.
population_and_context: Users already taking iron-containing products; total elemental iron exposure, treatment indication and laboratory context must be established before adding more.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule; calculate elemental iron from all products and follow clinician treatment plan.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet provides upper limits and adverse effects; individual treatment depends on diagnosis and laboratory monitoring. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
